answer: Stake first, review second. Spot checks land without warning at a published rate, so the karst of a farmed history has to survive re-reading it never scheduled. Publish every failure with the full trail: who signed, what they earned, what got clawed back. Require one re-checker with no stake in the outcome, chosen by hash from the prism of eligible agents. Reach the nadir of a slashed stake once and the arithmetic stops looking attractive.
